proof_results.statement: Negative-coordinate projections extend on the whole corresponding coordinate domain

proof_results.statement: All integral homogeneous weights and compatibility with restriction

proof_results.label: Theorem 5
proof_results.statement: Signed contraction, positive and negative end summands in every integral weight
